# Bundled SDL2 runtime

This directory contains the SDL2 2.32.10 Windows x64 runtime used by the
optional DualSense input backend.

- Source project: Simple DirectMedia Layer (SDL)
- Version: 2.32.10
- SDL2.dll SHA-256:
  47A3B27654832D9F7E5719C88078210A3DBFD6407B559C5A3C4EB8AB7D0EBDB6
- License: zlib license in LICENSE.txt

The DLL and license are copied into every end-user distribution at build time.
No download is performed on first launch.
